clips.text: I flew six hours for that pun?
clips.script: [dry, mock-exhausted] I flew SIX hours... [deadpan] for that pun?

clips.text: Scarier than movie night. Remember? You threw the whole popcorn bowl.
clips.script: [mellow, laid-back, low-key, low-key, amused] Scarier than movie night. [mellow, laid-back, low-key, dry, teasing] Remember? You threw the whole popcorn bowl.

clips.text: Number eight is in Los Angeles. Call me BEFORE you touch it. I sharpened the pencil.
clips.script: [brisk, bossy] Number eight is in Los Angeles. [firm, urgent] Call me BEFORE you touch it. [proud, matter-of-fact] I sharpened the pencil.

clips.text: If everybody is stuck, nobody can leave. No moving trucks. No airports. No goodbyes.
clips.script: [deep, slow, stubborn] If everybody is stuck, nobody can leave. [listing, grumbling] No moving trucks. No airports. [lonely, low] No goodbyes.

clips.text: 3468. You're back. Don't touch that. It's on my street.
clips.script: [clipped, commanding] Three four six eight. You're back. [sharp] Don't touch that. [possessive, flat] It's on MY street.
